rv.q: It's reliably crowd-pleasing and family-friendly, with a string of familiar set pieces to delight those who come back year after year.
It’s the perfect sparkling way to kick off your festive season.
This production provides great fun for all the family - we enjoyed it so much, we’ll have to see it again then, won’t we?
Sleeping Beauty is very much awake, picking up momentum as the best pantos do, with Simpson, Dale and Almgill outstanding and Moss making sure everyone keeps their wits about them.
The audience knows just what to expect and the show never disappoints.

cn.t: York Theatre Royal's Sleeping Beauty earns strong notices for its crowd-pleasing comedy and energetic cast, though some find the well-worn formula feeling familiar. Reliably entertaining festive fun that mostly delivers.
